title: Interteam Handoff & Surge Allocator Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a pragmatic playbook that prescribes how to reallocate staff and hand off work across product, eng, and design during an in-cycle surge or unexpected blocker. Focus on decision triggers, role shadowing, minimum-slate rules, and a lightweight coordination checklist so teams can safely trim scope or temporarily reassign engineers without losing momentum on high-priority initiatives.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook includes explicit surge triggers (utilization, bug backlog, SLA risk) and decision authority
Role-swap and shadowing steps documented with timeboxes and success metrics
Minimum-slate rules for critical initiatives defined and ratified by PM leads
Runbook includes template comms, ownership handoff checklist, and rollback criteria
Two trials executed in the next cycle with measured time-to-stabilize and retrospective notes
